content_units: Best GRU–LIM Itinerary for Your Budget
For one adult in economy with   1 checked bag  ,   max budget $420  , and a   strong preference for under 9 hours each way  , the best choice is   Option C  .
-   Why it wins:   It is the   only nonstop itinerary  , keeps both directions   well under 9 hours  , and   includes the checked bag
-   Comfort/time fit:   Best by a wide margin
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
Option B   23:40   08:15   10h35   1 stop   USD 341 + USD 60 bag
Option 1:   Option C     Fastest and simplest round trip; nonstop both ways; bag included     Best overall fit
Option 2:   Option A     Cheaper than C and still within your time preference on both directions     Best value backup
Option 3:   Option B     Lower base fare, but total becomes   $401   with bag and travel times are far too long     Budget okay, time poor
Option 4:   Option D     Cheapest fare, but 2 stops each way and both directions exceed your preferred limit     Lowest cost, weakest itinerary
C costs only   $27 more   than A, but saves nearly   4 hours outbound   and about   2h40 return  , while removing the connection risk entirely.
A is the best fallback if you want to stay comfortably below budget. It still fits your   under-9-hours   preference both ways and includes the bag.
Looks cheap at first, but with the checked bag it becomes   $401  . Even then, it misses your key priority badly with   10h35 outbound   and   11h30 return  .
Cheapest, but the long durations and   2 stops each way   make it the worst match for your stated priorities.
Choose   Option C   if your top priorities are   time, convenience, and staying under $420 total  .
Choose   Option A   only if saving   $27   matters more than flying nonstop.
